summary: WISeQey Corp. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) disclosing an October 8, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger among GigCapital8 Corp., PubCo Quantisimo Holdings, and WISeQey/SEALSQ, which own 100% of target Quantisimo. SPAC Merger Sub will merge into GigCapital8 first, then Target Merger Sub into Quantisimo, making PubCo the public holding company. GigCapital8 units split into Class A shares and one-fifth-share rights; each share converts into one PubCo ordinary share. Closing awaits shareholder approvals. Watch SPAC redemptions, extension risk, and contribution of Miraex, SEALCOIN, WeCan, and WISeSat.Space.
